purpose: Frozen per-task and aggregate metric contract for OPWS R1. Deterministic identities; no runtime treated as LLM token efficiency.

behavior_sufficient.definition: 1 iff every required frozen F2P node passes on the OPWS-patched worktree (strict semantics)

preservation_pass.definition: 1 iff every frozen stable-pass preservation identity passes on the OPWS worktree

scope_size_files.definition: |canonical normalized selected file list| for the task/arm

co_reported_per_task.recall_gap: historical_recall < 1 AND opws_joint_pass == 1; interpretation limited to 'historically changed non-test file not required under the frozen observed behavior+preservation contract'
co_reported_per_task.patch_status_code: raw scoped patch-application status when not clean
co_reported_per_task.duplicate_prediction_count: duplicate paths removed from scope at normalization
co_reported_per_task.invalid_prediction_path_count: listed paths absent at parent, excluded, with reason

optional_execution_diagnostics.schema_note: diagnostics are execution metadata ONLY; OPWS runtime is NOT LLM token efficiency and is NOT compared across arms as an efficiency metric

primary_aggregate_outcomes_per_arm.BEHAVIOR_SUFFICIENCY_RATE: mean(behavior_sufficient) over the arm's eligible task denominator
primary_aggregate_outcomes_per_arm.PRESERVATION_PASS_RATE: mean(preservation_pass) over the arm's eligible task denominator
primary_aggregate_outcomes_per_arm.JOINT_OPWS_PASS_RATE: mean(opws_joint_pass) over the arm's eligible task denominator
primary_aggregate_outcomes_per_arm.SCOPE_SIZE_DISTRIBUTION: full scope-size distribution (counts and percentiles; include for each arm - mean/median/sd/p01/p25/p50/p75/p99)

aggregate_denominator_rule: denominator = tasks in the bound population that are OPWS_ELIGIBLE for that arm, after invalid classes are removed to OPWS_INVALID_TASKS.json with visible reasons; never silently excluded
primary_rq3_visualization: sufficiency-scope frontier: x = scope_size_files, y = behavior_sufficiency/joint pass rate; one point per arm per task with per-arm aggregates and per-task scatter
